designationHistory.name: Tahquitz National Game Preserve
designationHistory.indexText: Congress created the Tahquitz National Game Preserve in the San Bernardino National Forest, Riverside County, California.
designationHistory.note: The act made the preserve subject to the condition that the land within its boundary first become the property of the United States.
